first_message.raw_markdown:
Hi everyone,
I'm curious how much score variation you're seeing when submitting the same solution multiple times, with no changes to the code, model, or strategy.
Do your leaderboard scores stay fairly consistent, or do they fluctuate noticeably? For anyone who has tried this, it would be helpful to hear the approximate score range or standard deviation, how many runs you've compared, and whether you kept the random seeds fixed.
